title: docs: error-handling, error-catalog and cli pages still say a controlled_by_parent master is always required (optional master, cards #30905/#30906)
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

Filing gate: out-of-scope finding from #30907 (PR #31092). That card's ask named five permissions pages; the card thread and the contract review (6703355433) found these other `content/docs` pages still teaching a required-only master. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
class: c · reach: every reader of the error reference and the CLI upgrade docs.

## What is stale (on `main` `719a502b`)

Since #30905 / #30906 (maintainer ruling 「A」), a `controlled_by_parent` object may have one OPTIONAL master (`required: false`); a stored empty reference on it is not a `422`.

1. `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`: L286 and L559–562 (a stored null master answers `422`; now a required master only); L568–577 (the declaration table and "Only the first row is a declaration the parse accepts"); L590–596 ("exactly one `master_detail` field declared `required: true`").
2. `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`: L189–196 and L1014 (the same `422`); L214–216 ("the master is exactly one `master_detail` declared `required: true`").
3. `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: L2142 (the v18 upgrade's refused stored shapes still list "an explicit `required: false`", which is now the optional master, `cbp-optional-master-admitted`); L2707–2711 (the `--parent-write-reach` paragraph).

Release pages (`content/docs/releases/**`) are release-owned and not listed. Re-read each site against `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` and the cbp read filter / write gate before rewording; PR #31092's permissions pages are the wording to agree with.

**Level:** docs only (`skip-changeset` unless triage says otherwise).

Related: #30907, PR #31092, #31094, #30905, #30906.
